title: Anne Frank House

orientationControl.basis: The three-bay black storefront at 263 lies between the 261 gabled cafe and 265 corniced house. The mapped whole-house envelope is partitioned into front house/link/annex using museum cutaway proportions. Neighboring rear feature 35184638705211 is excluded.

notes: The 5.88 by 24.1 m generalized envelope covers the front house and annex. Photo-derived partition: front z=3.3..16.7, connecting section z=-0.1..3.3, annex z=-7.4..-0.1. The rear roof ridge is transverse to the front-house ridge. These partitions are interpretive, not cadastral or measured. Modern museum and adjoining houses excluded.
limitations: Map is generalized at zoom 15; partition, windows and heights are visual estimates.
Historical cutaway establishes hidden exterior arrangement; contemporary facade follows Qualla photos.
Independent coarse host-terrain evidence is retained separately; no elevation survey is claimed.
